exposure: duration of exposure to maternal incarceration
duration of exposure to maternal binge drinking
cohort: The study involved 1693 cases from the National Longitudinal Surveys of Youth 1979 cohort, linking childhood adversity experiences across two generations to birth outcomes in the youngest generation.
finding: Neither the count nor the duration of ACE exposure was a statistically significant predictor of examined birth outcomes, with the exception of greater ACE numbers being associated with prolonged infant length of stay.
mod_finding: No association was found between ACEs and the route of delivery.
